page.title: Solutions
page.description: Lists, workflows and apps installed together into this workspace. Applying a solution creates what it declares and updates what it changed; it never deletes, and stored items stay as they are.
page.needScope: Installing solutions needs manage access to the workspace and the solution.manage scope, which administrators have.
page.empty: No solution is installed in this workspace.
page.removeDescription: Its workflows, apps and views are deleted. Its lists, content types and fields stay, with every item they hold.

install.title: Install or update
install.description: Choose a packed solution, the ZIP that papergo solution pack writes. Nothing changes until you apply.
install.reviewFirst: Review what applying would change before you apply.

plan.heading: {{name}} {{version}}
plan.slotUsesMissing: A list of the solution {{solution}}, which is not installed here
plan.noChanges: Applying changes nothing: the workspace already matches the solution.
plan.paused: Install paused: keep its workflows from starting on their own
plan.prune: Delete the workflows, apps and views this version no longer has
plan.stale: You changed a choice. Review again to see what applying does now.
